name: murmur
description: Claude Code speaks: turn summaries, needs-you alerts, background tasks, progress check-ins and rate-limit warnings, each session in its own voice (murmur: Kokoro on the Apple Neural Engine)

speakWhen.title: Speak when
speakWhen.description: away: only when this terminal isn't the focused one (Ghostty; elsewhere, always). always: whenever something happens

turnSummaries.title: Turn summaries
turnSummaries.description: Say what a long turn did when it finishes

summaryStyle.title: Summary style
summaryStyle.description: haiku: a one-line summary written by Claude Haiku (a tiny API call). first-sentence: the answer's first sentence, free

minTurnSeconds.title: Long turn (seconds)
minTurnSeconds.description: Turns shorter than this finish without a summary

needsYou.title: Needs you
needsYou.description: Say when Claude needs permission or asks a question

backgroundTasks.title: Background tasks
backgroundTasks.description: Say when a background task finishes

checkins.title: Progress check-ins
checkins.description: During long turns, say what's in progress

checkinMinutes.title: Check-in every (minutes)
checkinMinutes.description: How often a long turn checks in

rateLimitWarnings.title: Rate-limit warnings
rateLimitWarnings.description: Warn once per usage window when it passes the threshold

rateLimitPercent.title: Rate-limit threshold (%)
rateLimitPercent.description: Warn when a usage window passes this

voice.title: Fixed voice
voice.description: One voice for every session (e.g. bf_emma). Empty: each session gets its own

voices.title: Session voices
voices.description: Comma-separated voices handed to sessions in order. Empty: murmur's default mix
